headline: College student tied to tree and beaten in Cox’s Bazar’s Teknaf
summary: The victim, a second-year commerce student, was allegedly forcibly undressed and had her hair cut by attackers in public.
details: A college student was allegedly beaten, forcibly undressed, and had her hair cut after being tied to a tree in the Toingaghati area of Teknaf upazila, Cox’s Bazar, on Wednesday afternoon.
The victim, a second-year student of Cox’s Bazar Commerce College, reported that she was returning home after withdrawing Tk 15,000 for her father's medical treatment when her easy-bike was stopped.
She alleged that the attackers dragged her out of the vehicle by her hair, beat her, tore off her clothes, and assaulted her in public while many people filmed the incident.
The student further claimed that the attackers tied her to a tree, continued beating her and cut her hair, and stole Tk 15,000 and her gold earrings.
Police said the attack was allegedly motivated by accusations of an extramarital relationship with the prime accused's husband, though the student denied the allegations.
The student stated that the man, who is her cousin, had recently proposed to her after divorcing his wife.

Police from the Baharchhara Investigation Centre and Teknaf Police Station responded to a 999 emergency call and rescued the student, who was later taken to the Teknaf Upazila Health Complex for treatment.
The victim filed a case naming 10 people. Police have detained two women, Mursheda and her sister Rehena, who have been sent to jail by a court order.
caption:
A college student was allegedly tied to a tree, beaten and forcibly undressed in public in Teknaf.

A college student was allegedly beaten, forcibly undressed, and had her hair cut after being tied to a tree in the Toingaghati area of Teknaf upazila, Cox’s Bazar, on Wednesday afternoon.

The victim, a second-year student of Cox’s Bazar Commerce College, reported that she was returning home after withdrawing Tk 15,000 for her father's medical treatment when her easy-bike was stopped.

She alleged that the attackers dragged her out of the vehicle by her hair, beat her, tore off her clothes, and assaulted her in public while many people filmed the incident.

The student further claimed that the attackers tied her to a tree, continued beating her and cut her hair, and stole Tk 15,000 and her gold earrings.

Police said the attack was allegedly motivated by accusations of an extramarital relationship with the prime accused's husband, though the student denied the allegations.

The student stated that the man, who is her cousin, had recently proposed to her after divorcing his wife.

Police from the Baharchhara Investigation Centre and Teknaf Police Station responded to a 999 emergency call and rescued the student, who was later taken to the Teknaf Upazila Health Complex for treatment.

The victim filed a case naming 10 people. Police have detained two women, Mursheda and her sister Rehena, who have been sent to jail by a court order.
